# Background & aims

1.  

# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(glmmTMB)
library(easystats)
library(broom.mixed)

data_traits_climate_raw <- arrow::read_parquet("data-processed/data_traits_climate.parquet") |>
  select(decimal_longitude:life_stage, growth_form_simpler, life_history, woody) |>
  mutate(value = ifelse(trait_name == "leaf_delta13C", (-8 - value) / (1 + (value / 1000)), value)) %>%
  mutate(
    log_annual_precipitation = log(annual_precipitation),
    log_value = log(value)
  )

# Let's also collect the mean rainfall and temp for each species, and devitations of each from their respective mean. Only taking one record per cell to avoid pseudoreplication.
data_spp_climates <- data_traits_climate_raw |>
  group_by(taxon_name, cell) |>
  summarise(
    log_annual_precipitation = mean(log_annual_precipitation),
    average_temperature = mean(average_temperature)
  ) |>  ungroup() |>
  group_by(taxon_name) |>
  summarise(
    ncell = n(),
    log_annual_precipitation_mn = mean(log_annual_precipitation),
    average_temperature_mn = mean(average_temperature),
  ) 

data_traits_climate <- data_traits_climate_raw |>
  left_join(data_spp_climates, by = "taxon_name") |>
  mutate(
    log_annual_precipitation_c = log_annual_precipitation - log_annual_precipitation_mn,
    log_temperature_c = average_temperature - average_temperature_mn
  )

```

# new approach - a single model

```{r}
data_model <- data_traits_climate |> filter(
  !is.na(log_value) & woody == "woody",
  trait_name == "leaf_mass_per_area"
)

fit5 <- glmmTMB(log_value ~ log_annual_precipitation_mn + log_annual_precipitation_c + (log_annual_precipitation_c | taxon_name), data = data_model)

data_fit5 <- estimate_expectation(fit5) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    log_value = Predicted,
    value = exp(Predicted),
    CI_low = exp(CI_low),
    CI_high = exp(CI_high)
  )

data_fit5_global <-
  estimate_means(fit5, by = "log_annual_precipitation_mn") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(log_annual_precipitation = log_annual_precipitation_mn, log_value = Mean) |>
  mutate(
    annual_precipitation = exp(log_annual_precipitation),
    value = exp(log_value),
    taxon_name = "average"
  )

data_fit5_mn <- estimate_expectation(fit5,
  data = data_fit5 |> mutate(log_annual_precipitation_c = 0)
) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    log_value_mn = Predicted,
    value_mn = exp(Predicted),
    CI_low_mn = exp(CI_low),
    CI_high_mn = exp(CI_high)
  ) |>
  select(
    log_annual_precipitation_mn, taxon_name,
    log_value_mn, value_mn, CI_low_mn, CI_high_mn
  ) |>
  distinct()

data_fit5_all <-
  data_fit5 |>
  select(-SE, -Residuals) |>
  left_join(
    by = c("log_annual_precipitation_mn", "taxon_name"),
    data_fit5_mn
  ) |>
  mutate(
    log_annual_precipitation = log_annual_precipitation_mn + log_annual_precipitation_c,
    annual_precipitation = exp(log_annual_precipitation),
    annual_precipitation_mn = exp(log_annual_precipitation_mn),
  )

taxa <- data_model |>
  filter(ncell > 1) |>
  pull(taxon_name) |>
  unique() |>
  sample(10)

taxa <- c("Eucalyptus tectifica", "Myristica insipida", "Grevillea huegelii", "Ichnocarpus frutescens", "Leptospermum scoparium", "Styphelia humifusa", "Hakea gibbosa", "Acronychia vestita")

data_model_taxa <- data_model |>
  filter(taxon_name %in% taxa) |>
  mutate(taxon2 = taxon_name)

data_fit5_taxa <- data_fit5_all |>
  filter(taxon_name %in% taxa) |>
  mutate(
    taxon2 = taxon_name
  )

data_fit5_taxa_mn <- data_fit5_taxa |>
  select(taxon2, annual_precipitation_mn, value_mn, CI_low_mn, CI_high_mn) |>
  distinct()

p_fit <-
  data_fit5_all |>
  ggplot(aes(annual_precipitation, value, group = taxon_name)) +
  # raw data
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, col = "grey", data = data_model, stroke = 0) +
  # fitted lines
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5, col = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  # highlight certain species
  geom_ribbon(aes(group = taxon2, ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high), col = NA, fill = "purple", alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE, data = data_fit5_taxa) +
  geom_line(aes(group = taxon2), col = "purple", alpha = 1, show.legend = FALSE, data = data_fit5_taxa) +
  geom_point(aes(group = taxon2), col = "orange", show.legend = FALSE, data = data_model_taxa, size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(x = annual_precipitation_mn, y = value_mn, group = taxon2), alpha = 0.5, data = data_fit5_taxa_mn, col = "red") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = annual_precipitation_mn, y = value_mn, group = taxon2, ymin = CI_low_mn, ymax = CI_high_mn), width = 0, alpha = 0.5, data = data_fit5_taxa_mn, col = "red") +

  # geom_line(data = data_fit5_global, col = "red") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(10, 1000)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y = "Leaf mass per area (g/m2, log scale)", x = "annual rainfall (mm/yr, log scale)", title = "Model-averages for within species trends") +
#  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~taxon2, ncol = 4)

ggsave("outputs/LMA_MAP_8.png", p_fit, width = 12, height = 6)
```

```{r}
# model across species means
parameters(fit2)

data_fit2 <- estimate_expectation(fit2) |>
  as_tibble()|>
  mutate(
    annual_precipitation = exp(log_annual_precipitation),
    value = exp(Predicted)
  )
 
data_fit2_global <- estimate_means(fit2, by = "log_annual_precipitation") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(log_annual_precipitation, log_value = Mean) |>
  mutate(
    annual_precipitation = exp(log_annual_precipitation),
    value = exp(log_value),
    taxon_name = "average"
  )

data_fit2_taxa <- 
  data_fit2 |>
  filter(taxon_name %in% taxa) |>
  mutate(taxon2 = taxon_name)

p_fit <-
  data_fit2_all |>
  ggplot(aes(annual_precipitation, value, group = taxon_name)) +
  # raw data
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, col = "grey", data = data_model, stroke = 0) +
  # fitted lines
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5, col = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  # highlight certain species
  geom_point(aes(group = taxon2), col = "orange", show.legend = FALSE, data = data_model_taxa, size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(group = taxon2), col = "orange", alpha = 1, show.legend = FALSE, data = data_fit2_taxa) +
  geom_line(data = data_fit2_global, col = "red") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y = trait, x = "annual rainfall") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~taxon2)

ggsave("multiplot_fitted3-classic.png", p_fit)
```

Wood density

```{r}
data_model <- data_traits_climate |>
  filter(woody, trait_name == "wood_density") |>
  mutate(log_value = log(value), log_annual_precipitation = log(wc2.1_2.5m_bio_12))

library(glmmTMB)

fit0 <- glmmTMB(log_value ~ log_annual_precipitation, data = data_model)
fit1 <- glmmTMB(log_value ~ log_annual_precipitation + (1 | taxon_name), data = data_model)
fit2 <- glmmTMB(log_value ~ log_annual_precipitation + (log_annual_precipitation | taxon_name), data = data_model)

# strong support for random slopes
anova(fit0, fit1, fit2)

# mixed effect model slopes (by species) flatter than species agnostic fit
parameters(fit0)
parameters(fit2)

random_slopes_fit2 <- broom.mixed::tidy(fit2, effects = "ran_vals") |>
  filter(term == "log_annual_precipitation") |>
  select(level, estimate) |>
  rename(taxon_name = level, random_slope = estimate)

pt <- random_slopes_fit2 |>
  ggplot(aes(random_slope)) +
  geom_histogram()
ggsave("tmp.png", pt)


# plot fitted lines
library(easystats)

data_fit <- estimate_expectation(fit2) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(across(c("log_annual_precipitation", "Predicted"), exp))

p_fit <- data_fit |>
  ggplot(aes(log_annual_precipitation, Predicted, group = taxon_name)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y = "Wood desnity", x = "annual rainfall")

ggsave("pfit_WD.png", p_fit)
```

Try removing means
```{r}
data_model <-
  data_traits_climate |>
  filter(woody, trait_name == "leaf_area") |>
  mutate(
    log_value = log(value),
    log_annual_precipitation = log(wc2.1_2.5m_bio_12)
  ) |>
  group_by(taxon_name) |>
  mutate(
    log_annual_precipitation_mn = mean(log_annual_precipitation),
    log_annual_precipitation_c = log_annual_precipitation - log_annual_precipitation_mn
  ) |>
  ungroup()

fit0 <- glmmTMB(log_value ~ log_annual_precipitation, data = data_model)

# Cenetred model
fit2 <- glmmTMB(log_value ~ log_annual_precipitation_c + (log_annual_precipitation_c | taxon_name), data = data_model)

# Estimate values at species means
fit3 <- glmmTMB(log_value ~ log_annual_precipitation + (log_annual_precipitation | taxon_name), data = data_model)

data_centers <- data_model |>
  select(taxon_name, log_annual_precipitation = log_annual_precipitation_mn) |>
  distinct()

pred_centers <- estimate_prediction(fit3, data_centers) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  rename(log_value = Predicted)

# model across species means
fit4 <- glmmTMB(log_value ~ log_annual_precipitation, data = pred_centers)

data_fit4 <- estimate_prediction(fit4, data = pred_centers |> select(taxon_name, log_annual_precipitation, log_value)) |>
  as_tibble()

parameters(fit4)

p_fit <-
  pred_centers |>
  ggplot(aes(log_annual_precipitation, log_value)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(data = data_fit4, aes(y = Predicted)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y = "Leaf size", x = "annual rainfall")
ggsave("tmp.png", p_fit)


# plot fitted lines for Cenetred model

data_fit <- estimate_expectation(fit2) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(across(c("log_annual_precipitation_c", "Predicted"), exp))

p_fit <- data_fit |>
  ggplot(aes(log_annual_precipitation_c, Predicted, group = taxon_name)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y = "Leaf size", x = "cenetred annual rainfall")

ggsave("pfit_Leaf_size_c.png", p_fit)
```



## Compare two methods

Compare species slopes in 2 methods

```{r}
# Centered version
species_slopes_c <-
  broom.mixed::tidy(fit2, effects = "ran_vals") |>
  filter(term == "log_annual_precipitation_c") |>
  select(level, estimate) |>
  rename(taxon_name = level, slope_c = estimate)

# non-centered version
B_fixed <- parameters(fit3) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  filter(Parameter == "log_annual_precipitation") |>
  pull(Coefficient)

species_slopes_r <-
  broom.mixed::tidy(fit3, effects = "ran_vals") |>
  filter(term == "log_annual_precipitation") |>
  select(level, estimate) |>
  rename(taxon_name = level, slope_r = estimate) |>
  mutate(slope_r = slope_r + B_fixed)

species_slopes <- left_join(species_slopes_r, species_slopes_c)

p <- ggplot(species_slopes, aes(slope_c, slope_r)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", col = "red")
ggsave("tmp.png", p)
```

Fixed effects:  Average fixed effect slopes differ a lot

```{r}
# In pooled model -- slope = 1.28
parameters(fit0)

# In random effects model - slope = 0.51
parameters(fit3)

# Across species means -- slope = 1.64
parameters(fit4)

# Range of within species slopes - mean slope = -0.06 ([-0.20, 0.09])
parameters(fit2)

stats::quantile(species_slopes_c$slope_c, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.9))
```
